item.title: Them Among Us: No Nation for the Less Equals
item.description: Call for papers for a Guest-edited special issue by Dr. Debajyoti Biswas, Associate Professor,Department of English, Bodoland University, Kokrajhar and Professor Om Prakash Dwivedi, Professor of English Literature, Director, School of Liberal Arts, Chandigarh University, Lucknow This special issue focuses on the critical practices that define the concept of the New Xenophobia, linked as it is to the varied forms of Othering and violence in the age of neoliberalism.
